condepe

R access to the open data of the Observatório de Pernambuco, published by Condepe/Fidem (the Pernambuco State Agency for Planning and Research): municipal series on population, economy, public finance, labour, education, health, security, transport and environment for the 185 municipalities of Pernambuco, Brazil.

Every source is published in the same long format (one observation per row, 15 columns), so one set of functions covers all of them, returning tibbles.

Installation 

install.packages("condepe")   # once on CRAN

# development version:
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("StrategicProjects/condepe-r")

Usage 

library(condepe)

# Sources available (one row each), with the catalogue version
cat <- condepe_catalog()
attr(cat, "version")

# Indicators of a source
condepe_indicators("sidra_populacao_estimada")

# A series: Recife (IBGE 2611606), 2020 onwards
condepe_series(
  "sidra_populacao_estimada", "Populacao residente estimada",
  code = "2611606", years = 2020:2026
)

# A whole source, and the municipality list
condepe_data("datasus_sinasc")
condepe_localities()

Column names are kept in Portuguese, as published, so results stay traceable to the official files: cd_municipio_ibge, nm_municipio, ano, mes, indicador, indicador_base, valor, unidade, natureza, id_fonte, eixo, tema, assunto, fonte_original, arquivo_origem. Monthly series carry the period in indicador ("... [MM/YYYY]") and mes; indicador_base is the label without it.

Where the data come from

  • Canonical: https://cf.pe.gov.br/observatorio/dados/atual/
  • Mirror (fallback): the Hugging Face dataset mlkwy/observatorio-pernambuco, with the same relative paths.

Files are cached on disk per catalogue version (condepe_cache_dir()) and checked against the SHA-256 published in the catalogue; the catalogue itself is trusted for 6 hours. If neither backend answers, functions warn and return a zero-row tibble with the documented columns. Options are listed in ?condepe.

Documentation: https://strategicprojects.github.io/condepe-r/.

Citation and license

Data: Condepe/Fidem, Observatório de Pernambuco — Base de Dados do Estado, CC BY 4.0. The citation with the version in use is in attr(condepe_catalog(), "citation").

Code: MIT. To read or write private buckets on s3.pe.gov.br with an access key, see s3pe; condepe needs no key, since the Observatory open data are public. A Python package with the same functions is condepe for Python.
